tools.name: knock_list_users
tools.description: List users in the current Knock environment, newest first unless ordered otherwise. Use it to find a user id before other calls. Knock API: GET /v1/users.

tools.name: knock_get_user
tools.description: Get one Knock user by id: name, email, phone number, timezone and timestamps. Knock API: GET /v1/users/{user_id}.

tools.name: knock_list_user_messages
tools.description: List the in-app and channel messages sent to one user, filterable by channel, status, workflow run and insertion time. Knock API: GET /v1/users/{user_id}/messages.

tools.name: knock_list_messages
tools.description: List messages across the environment, filterable by channel, status, source, tenant, workflow run and insertion time. Knock API: GET /v1/messages.

tools.name: knock_get_message
tools.description: Get one message by id: channel, status, recipient, workflow, engagement timestamps (seen, read, interacted, archived). Knock API: GET /v1/messages/{message_id}.

tools.name: knock_get_message_content
tools.description: Get the rendered content (subject, body, and channel data) of one message. Knock API: GET /v1/messages/{message_id}/content.

tools.name: knock_list_message_delivery_logs
tools.description: List the delivery attempts and provider responses for one message, to see why a delivery failed. Knock API: GET /v1/messages/{message_id}/delivery_logs.

tools.name: knock_list_workflow_recipient_runs
tools.description: List workflow runs per recipient, filterable by workflow key, status, recipient, tenant, errors and time range. Use it to check whether a triggered workflow ran for a user. Knock API: GET /v1/workflow_recipient_runs.

tools.name: knock_get_workflow_recipient_run
tools.description: Get one workflow recipient run with its events, to see each step a workflow ran for one recipient. Knock API: GET /v1/workflow_recipient_runs/{id}.

tools.name: knock_list_tenants
tools.description: List tenants (groups of users, such as customer accounts) in the current environment. Knock API: GET /v1/tenants.

tools.name: knock_get_tenant
tools.description: Get one tenant by id: name and settings. Knock API: GET /v1/tenants/{id}.

tools.name: knock_trigger_workflow
tools.description: Run a Knock workflow for the given recipients. This SENDS real notifications through the channels the workflow defines (email, SMS, push, in-app). Set cancellation_key to cancel the run later. Knock API: POST /v1/workflows/{key}/trigger.

tools.name: knock_cancel_workflow
tools.description: Cancel queued runs of a workflow that match a cancellation_key set when the run was triggered. Runs already sent cannot be recalled. Knock API: POST /v1/workflows/{key}/cancel.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: knock_get_user, knock_list_user_messages, knock_list_messages, knock_get_message, knock_get_message_content, knock_list_message_delivery_logs · Public sink: knock_get_user, knock_trigger_workflow, knock_cancel_workflow · Destructive: knock_list_user_messages, knock_list_messages, knock_get_workflow_recipient_run, knock_trigger_workflow, knock_cancel_workflow.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: knock_get_user, knock_list_user_messages, knock_list_messages, knock_get_message, knock_get_message_content, knock_list_message_delivery_logs · Public sink: knock_get_user, knock_trigger_workflow, knock_cancel_workflow · Destructive: knock_list_user_messages, knock_list_messages, knock_get_workflow_recipient_run, knock_trigger_workflow, knock_cancel_workflow

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
